hypothesis: after correcting action scale, residual failure is caused by sequential closed-loop planning if the policy changes buttons and transiently reduces button-state Hamming distance; failure before any button transition instead implicates contact/control
exact_change: evaluate frozen action_weight-1 and action_weight-10 seed-42 auxiliary iMF EMA checkpoints with method-neutral puzzle-progress recording; do not change policy, sampler, seeds, task, horizon, or NFE
expected_if_true: action_weight-10 produces button transitions and positive best progress but later regresses or fails to complete the sequence
expected_if_false: action_weight-10 produces no button transition or no improvement in button-state Hamming distance
metrics: initial/final/minimum button-state Hamming distance to goal

interpretation.sequential_signal: at least two of three action_weight-10 episodes have button transitions and positive best progress
interpretation.regression_signal: positive best progress followed by a worse final Hamming distance
interpretation.contact_failure_signal: no button transitions in at least two of three action_weight-10 episodes
interpretation.scope: mechanism diagnostic only; three paired episodes are not a benchmark estimate
